resources.string: Network speed with draggable overlay + live notification + status-bar accessibility overlay
Show a draggable speed bubble on screen
Draw speed at the top of the screen like a status bar (accessibility overlay)
Keep an ongoing notification with live speed
Promote the notification as a live update (Android 16 QPR2)
This service displays the current network speed at the top of the screen using an accessibility overlay. No data is collected or transmitted.
• Grant overlay permission to show the speed bubble.
• Enable accessibility in settings for the status-bar overlay.
